# TradeGrowth Marketing

> Marketing for UK construction, engineering and design businesses. We help
> architects, MEP and building services engineers, structural engineers and
> interior designers — along with related built-environment consultancies and
> contractors — showcase their expertise, improve their visibility in search and
> in AI-assisted search, and attract more relevant project enquiries.

Website: https://tradegrowthseo.com
Contact: contact@tradegrowthseo.com
Coverage: United Kingdom, remote-first
Serves: UK construction, engineering and design businesses (not ecommerce or
  national consumer brands)
Availability: Taking on three new practices a quarter

## Who we work with

Primary disciplines:

- Architects and architectural practices
- MEP and building services engineers
- Structural engineers
- Interior designers and interior architecture studios

Also working with: civil engineering consultancies; building and quantity
surveyors; planning consultants; energy and sustainability consultants;
landscape architects; project management and construction consultancies;
specialist electrical and EV infrastructure design consultancies; main
contractors, design-and-build firms and specialist construction contractors.

Clients range from practices serving homeowners on residential projects to
consultancies selling to developers, contractors, architects and estates teams.

## What we do

- **Website design** — mobile-first websites of up to ten pages organised
  around project case studies, specialisms, sector experience and team
  credentials, with a straightforward enquiry journey. Built as part of
  Foundations (below) where the existing site cannot carry the work; otherwise
  the existing site is fixed and restructured in place. Domain registered in
  the client's name; hosting and SSL included for the first year.
- **SEO + AI-search visibility** (headline service) — search visibility for the
  client's services, project types and locations, targeted locally, regionally
  or nationally to match their actual market. Alongside it, the groundwork that
  makes a practice legible to AI-assisted search: structured data, question-led
  content, case studies drafted by us from a call with the client, consistent
  business information across trade bodies, and third-party mentions. No
  ranking, citation or AI recommendation is guaranteed; monthly reporting
  quotes Search Console totals and sampled AI-assistant answers.
- **Google & Meta ads** — an add-on for residential-facing practices only,
  where search intent exists. Google Search led; Meta where the work is visual.
  Not offered to national consultancies. Ad spend is paid by the client
  directly to the platforms. LinkedIn Ads management is not offered.
- **Enquiry management & follow-up** — in pilot with one client. Not sold. It
  will be priced when the pilot shows it works. It will not chase proposals,
  qualify opportunities, close sales, send SMS or run campaigns.

## Pricing (published in full)

Structure: one fixed-price 90-day project, then one optional month-to-month
retainer. There is no setup fee, no minimum term after the project, and no
percentage of ad spend.

- **Foundations on your site: £2,950**, fixed, 90 days, three equal monthly
  instalments. For practices whose existing site is sound underneath.
- **Foundations with a new site: £4,750**, fixed, 90 days, three equal monthly
  instalments. Includes a mobile-first site of up to ten pages, domain in the
  client's name, hosting and SSL for year one, and a launch date in writing.
- Every Foundations includes: a technical baseline measured on day one and day
  ninety; structured data for services, sectors and credentials; up to four
  project case studies drafted from a twenty-minute call each; service and
  sector pages rebuilt around buyers' real questions; consistent business
  details across trade bodies; Google Business Profile where local intent
  exists; a search and AI-visibility baseline at day one and day ninety; three
  monthly reports and a day-ninety review with a written plan.
- **Visibility retainer: £695/month**, month to month, 30 days' notice, billed
  monthly in advance, no minimum term. Includes a monthly report on Search
  Console totals with sampled AI visibility, one new case study or question-led
  page a month where there is a real question to answer, small site changes,
  and a quarterly review. Two tracks: residential-facing practices (Google
  Business Profile, local-intent pages, ads available) and national
  consultancies (mention outreach each quarter, sector case studies, no ads).
- **Add-ons:** Google Ads management £350/month plus the client's ad spend
  (residential-facing practices on the retainer only); additional site pages
  £150 each beyond the ten in a new site; enquiry management not yet sold.
- VAT: prices are not subject to VAT (TradeGrowth Marketing is not VAT
  registered). Hosting from year two: £95/year, or the site can be moved
  anywhere.

## Guarantees

Cover inputs and speed, never rankings, AI mentions or enquiry numbers.

1. Every Foundations item scheduled for the first thirty days is live within
   thirty days of receiving access, or the first instalment is refunded.
2. A new site goes live within twenty-eight days of content sign-off, or the
   final instalment is waived.
3. If the free audit shows the practice is already described well, we say so
   and stop.
4. The retainer is month to month; domain, site, reports and research belong
   to the client.
5. Reports quote Search Console totals; anything not measurable is marked as
   such, never estimated.

## Scope and costs

- The fee covers the listed scope. There is no separate setup fee.
- Domain renewal from year two, ad spend, and any paid tool run on the
  client's behalf are itemised and agreed before activation.
- Pages beyond the ten in a new site, photography, video and anything not on
  the published lists are quoted separately.
- Reporting depends on what can be measured: Search Console totals, sampled
  AI answers, and enquiries the client reports. Untracked calls and direct
  emails are not attributed to search.

Full comparison: https://tradegrowthseo.com/pricing/

## Case study

EV Design — an electrical design consultancy based in Burnley, Lancashire,
specialising in EV charging infrastructure and working on projects across the
UK. Ranks first on Google for local Burnley searches, is named in Google's AI
Overview as a North West specialist, and is described accurately by ChatGPT.
These are visibility results, evidenced by screenshots of live searches; no
enquiry or revenue figures are attributed to them.
